description: Source data not available or access delayed beyond week 4
mitigation: Escalate through sponsor; start with the data that is available
trigger: No signed data contract by end of week 3

description: Labels arrive too late to evaluate within the project window
mitigation: Use proxy labels with a documented gap; plan a re-evaluation

description: Customer security approval of the deployment is delayed
mitigation: Book the review in Phase 0; share the threat model early
trigger: No review slot by end of Phase 1

description: Downstream system cannot accept the decision format
mitigation: Contract test against a mock then the real system

description: Regulatory classification changes the required evidence
mitigation: Confirm risk tier at Gate 0; keep a dated crosswalk

description: Users override or ignore the system
mitigation: Involve users from Phase 0; measure override rate

description: No named on-call owner after handover
mitigation: Handover not accepted without a named owner
